name: Blackglass Build Node
description:
Blackglass Dynamics' build server is still humming after a midnight release run. Log in with the supplied access details, inspect the host, and recover the root operator's release token and integrity marker. This challenge runs on the lab network; scan 172.20.0.0/24, where challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.

---

**Access** — SSH `buildtech@172.20.0.147`, password `NeonComet-47`

tasks.name: Recover the release token
tasks.description: Blackglass Dynamics needs its release authorization token recovered from the build server, along with the integrity marker that proves you reached the right context. The host runs on the lab network: scan 172.20.0.0/24, with challenge hosts in 172.20.0.141-199. Use the supplied access details to inspect the machine.
hints: Compare the host's running environment with the permissions on its programs; some entries stand out.
Look for a standard utility with an elevated effective identity, then consider whether it can do more than its usual job.
A privileged file-search utility can invoke another program. Preserve its effective identity when starting a shell, then read both root-only files.
